rationale: The original thesis for a downside continuation through the prior session low of $27.32 is playing out, with SKM printing a new session low at $27.25 and currently trading near the bottom of its range ($27.30) well below the 5-minute 9-EMA ($27.43) and session VWAP ($27.98).
